title: 第26章 窄袖观音第27章 意根藏
lines: 冷不丁在阴暗的林中看到一个人影，苏午的心脏都要跳出嗓子眼儿。
尤其是那人木头似地立在溪边，更让他觉得有些诡异。
他打定主意不靠近小溪，挪动步子想要退离此地。
但在此时，那人转过了身来。
她的脸庞像是一个大大的桃子，白得发光般的面孔上，有两坨红彤彤的色泽糊在双颊。
大大的脸庞衬托得她脖颈很细。
像是扑克牌上桃心的把儿。
她没有鼻梁、鼻头，只有两个黑漆漆的鼻孔对着苏午。
小小的嘴巴像是一只草莓，微微蠕动，发出轻而细的声音：“你要去哪里呀？
带上我好不好？”
单听这个声音，会叫人油然想起自己遇到过的最温驯乖巧的女子。
轻柔而温暖的气息缠裹住苏午的脖颈，像是女孩儿环抱过来的手臂。
他低头看向自己的脖颈——两条白得发光的细嫩手臂已缠绕上他的脖颈！
诡！
苏午背后冷汗唰地一下浸透衣衫！
他想起‘卓杰’的父亲被一双双雪白手臂缠绕全身的画面，立时明白，自己遭遇了和卓杰父亲一样的诡。
这只在身后紧追着自己的诡，已经趁着自己松懈之时追了上来！
意识到危险的同时，苏午下意识想要转身逃跑——
然而，他转身的动作像是掉帧的画面，三个呼吸的时间都未能让他完成这个动作。
越来越多白嫩小手从他的袖口、衣襟里伸出，从不同方向环抱他，层层交叠！
“这诡……能……拖……慢……我的——速度！”
苏午勉强转动眼珠，看到那只诡从溪边倏忽‘飞’到了前面的树梢上。
像是一只被放飞的风筝，轻飘飘的没有多少重量。
‘她’与苏午离得更近，苏午才看到她翠绿色的厚袍子两侧，有两条紧窄的长袖。
两条窄袖袖口都打着结，在风里飘来荡去——诡的双臂似乎没有穿进窄袖里。
这就是卓杰父亲所说的‘窄袖观音’！
此时，‘窄袖观音’的腹部鼓囊囊的如同塞了个西瓜。
“卓杰的父亲，已经被它吃进肚子里了？”
盯着窄袖观音的腹部，苏午脑海里念头转动开来。
不知是因为自身将死的缘故、或是其他原因，这时他的思维又恢复了正常转动。
“你要去哪里呀？”
“带上我好不好？”
细声细气的声音再次从窄袖观音小草莓似的嘴唇里飘出。
距离苏午嘴巴最近的几只雪白小手纷纷张开五指，将他的嘴巴扒开，并试图往四面八方撕扯——
“啊啊啊啊！”
苏午嘴角都要被撕裂了！
他喉咙里迸出痛苦的声音！
偏偏他的嘴巴并未被真正撕裂，而是在那几只小手的撕扯下，越扩越大，即将能容纳一颗篮球！
窄袖观音从树梢上飞下来，她小小的脑袋试图钻进苏午篮球一般大的嘴。
这什么诡东西？！
苏午目呲欲裂，眼看着窄袖观音的脑袋即将钻进他嘴里之时，四周影影绰绰的林间忽然传来几声洪亮的犬吠！
“汪汪汪汪！”
狗？
他转动眼珠，眼角余光瞥见斜对面一条黑魁魁、壮若牛犊的大狗从林间窜出，朝着自己这边就扑了过来！
content_en:
Leng Buding saw a figure in the dark forest, and Su Wu's heart almost jumped out of his throat.
Especially the man standing like a tree by the stream made him feel a little weird.
He made up his mind not to get close to the creek and moved his steps to retreat from the place.
But at this moment, the man turned around.
Her face was like a big peach, with two bright red spots on her cheeks on her glowing white face.
Her big face made her neck very thin.
Like the heart handle on a playing card.
She had no nose bridge or tip, only two dark nostrils facing Su Wu.
The small mouth was like a strawberry, squirming slightly and making a soft and thin voice: "Where are you going?
Can you take me with you? "
Just listening to this voice will remind you of the most docile and well-behaved woman you have ever encountered.
The soft and warm breath wrapped around Su Wu's neck, like a girl's arms surrounding her.
He looked down at his neck - two gleaming white and delicate arms had wrapped around his neck!
sly!
The cold sweat on Su Wu's back suddenly soaked through his clothes!
He remembered the image of 'Zhuo Jie's' father being wrapped around his whole body by pairs of snow-white arms, and he immediately understood that he had encountered the same trick as Zhuo Jie's father.
This sly that was chasing him closely behind him had already caught up with him while he was slacking off!
When Su Wu realized the danger, he subconsciously wanted to turn around and run away——
However, his turning action seemed like a frame was dropped, and he could not complete this action even in three breaths.
More and more white and tender little hands stretched out from his cuffs and lapels, embracing him from different directions, overlapping each other!
"This trick...can...slow...slow...my-speed!"
"...and...thinking..."
Su Wu reluctantly rolled his eyes and saw the bird suddenly flying from the stream to the treetop in front.
Like a kite being flown, it is light and weightless.
'She' and Su Wu got closer, and Su Wu saw two long, narrow sleeves on both sides of her thick emerald robe.
The cuffs of the two narrow sleeves were knotted and fluttering in the wind - it seemed that Gui's arms were not inserted into the narrow sleeves.
This is what Zhuojie’s father called the ‘Narrow-sleeved Guanyin’!
At this time, the belly of ‘Narrow Sleeve Guanyin’ was as bulging as a watermelon.
"Zhuo Jie's father has been eaten by it?"
Staring at the belly of Narrow Sleeve Guanyin, Su Wu's thoughts began to swirl in his mind.
I don't know if it was because he was about to die or for other reasons, but at this time his thinking returned to normal.
"Where are you going?"
"Take me with you, okay?"
A soft voice floated out from the strawberry-like lips of Narrow Sleeve Guanyin again.
The few snow-white hands closest to Su Wu's mouth opened their fingers, opened his mouth, and tried to tear it in all directions——
"Ahhhhh!"
The corners of Su Wu's mouth were about to be torn apart!
A painful sound erupted from his throat!
However, his mouth was not really torn apart, but due to the tearing by those small hands, it expanded bigger and bigger, and was about to be able to accommodate a basketball!
The narrow-sleeved Guanyin flew down from the treetops, and her small head tried to get into Su Wu's mouth as big as a basketball.
What kind of weird thing is this? !
Su Wu's eyes were about to burst, and when he saw that the head of Narrow-Sleeved Guanyin was about to penetrate into his mouth, several loud barks suddenly came from the shadowy forest around him!
"Woof woof woof!"
Dog?
He rolled his eyes, and out of the corner of his eye he caught a glimpse of a large black dog as strong as a calf diagonally across from him, emerging from the forest and rushing towards him!
